info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Mortgage Loans Payoffs-v4-spec
info.description: This API provides access to a list of mortgage loan payoffs, enabling financial institutions and service providers to efficiently retrieve payoff information for their clients. Users can query specific loan details, including outstanding balances and payoff dates, ensuring accurate and timely processing of loan payoffs. Typical consumers include mortgage lenders, servicers, and real estate professionals who require up-to-date payoff information for their transactions. This endpoint streamlines the management of mortgage loans, facilitating smooth financial operations.

get.description: Fetches details regarding the payoff amounts for loans associated with a specific account. This endpoint provides important financial information to help users understand their loan obligations.

requestBody.description: Request body containing the necessary data to retrieve the payoff amount for loans. This should include all required parameters as specified in the schema.

200.description: Successful retrieval of loan payoff information.
